text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I want to compete in the Derby, I have
to push my body further
than ever!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
For the dream I share with Maruzen... and
starting from today, for you
too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O needs no reminder to
work hard. So if there's
anything I can do
as her trainer, it would be...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you going somewhere too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The bookstore! Wait, are you after The Complete Book of Winning Proverbs that just went on sale today too?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, n-never mind then. For a second there
I thought you were one of
us... Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but we're still going to the same
place. If you don't mind, how
about we go
together?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any reason to say no, so we
head to the bookstore
together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yay! Got what I came for!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The hottest new publication in the proverb
world... I don't know what
I would've done
if it was sold out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer? Don't tell me you're going
to buy that entire mountain
of books!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Your arms are shaking! I'll help
carry some!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There we go... I didn't know you were such
an avid reader.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Umamusume Growth Theory, and Post-Debut Training Techniques? Wait, are these all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They're for me, aren't they?! You really
didn't have to...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ohh... Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you and I do have something in
common after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All I could ever do was play it safe,
sticking it out and staying
dedicated to
practice, practice, and more practice...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I just kept fighting,
maybe I could move
at least a few steps
forward... That was
what kept me going.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The shoes I was trying to fill were so
big,
there were times when I
almost lost my
footing, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I kept working at it! Because
otherwise, I never would've met
such an
amazing trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In my room that night, as I'm digging into
the books I purchased...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To my hard-working trainer...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Today was fun! I feel like I was able to
learn a little more about you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and those training books! I bet you're
reading them right now,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It made me really happy to hear how you
felt! But don't feel like you
have to do so
much, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, a little proverb to cheer you on.
"Walk as two, leave footprints
of four!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So let's keep on forging ahead as two!
Okay, I'll see you at training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The proverb doesn't quite compute, but
it's the thought that counts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I start typing out a short thank you, then
change my mind and reach
for the call
button.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
H-hello? Chiyono O here! Did something
urgent come up?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is this about the message I just sent?
D-did I say something
weird?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thanks?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, I'm just glad I could be helpful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I think that was one of my best proverbs
yet! Feel free to use it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The proper usage of her proverb still
eludes me, but for now, I'll just
enjoy this
chat with Chiyono O.
